title: Villa d’Este
geometryBasis: OSM relation 270239, its exact 38-point exterior and two open 4-point courtyard boundaries. The mapped garden axis and fountain polygons establish the terrace layout.
sectionBasis: Original 512 m hill field, Piazza Trento threshold and front loggia aligned with the Fountain of the Dragons. The garden façade’s three floor bands and two projecting levels follow the photographs and UNESCO’s written inventory.
limitations: The model covers the standing palace, two open courtyards, entry, garden loggia, retaining terraces and principal exterior fountain structures. The neighbouring church, interior rooms and plantings are outside the architectural scope.

The original terrain is unchanged. Individual fountain floor levels, wing roof heights, parapets, staircase widths and unmeasured features are estimates based on the standing mapped outline, site descriptions and five verified Qualla originals.
The garden structures capture major architectural forms. Small carving, detailed statuary, planted beds, and active fountain hydraulics are simplified.
